dcf.formula: EV = Σ FCFF_t/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^5; Equity = EV − Net Debt; Price = Equity/Shares
dcf.formula_description: Five-year FCFF DCF. PV_t = FCFF_t/(1+WACC)^t; TV = FCFF5×(1+g)/(WACC-g); PVTV = TV/(1+WACC)^5; EV = ΣPV + PVTV; equity = EV − debt + cash; price = equity/shares.
